posts.title: From Android to QuakeCon: What 90s Game Engines Teach Us About Extreme Optimization
posts.description: Hear how recent rewrites of the ADB stack and Android Studio debugger directly improve developer workflows. By updating the mDNS implementation and rebuilding Windows USB drivers, you can rely on stable Wi-Fi connections and eliminate system freezing. The updated debugger agent provides accurate stepping and variable inspection for apps written in Kotlin. Watch Android Developers Backstage on YouT

posts.title: Android AI Tools: Vibe coding, sub-agents, and the Android CLI
posts.description: Learn how the latest Android Studio AI features can streamline your daily development tasks. posts.title: The inside story of Jetpack Compose
